execution_preflight: Require actual total existing M5 evidence +20MiB author +20MiB supervisor +4MiB contingency <=64MiB. Stop/report before cap; no deletion/recompression of old evidence.
trace_format: Full lossless compact UTF8 JSON gzip mtime0; raw/stored SHA256 and byte counts; complete mutable before/after accounts, actual getter/sysvar/meta/outcome records, no omissions or model receipts.
raw_response_policy: Only complete new captures may be gzip encoded; never strip/patch/trim binary. ProgramData full allocation and code relation retained; actual decoding checked.
if_build_becomes_necessary: Stop that dependency and present concrete need under internal design/handoff gates; do not install/build by inference.
monitor: Before and during capture/runtime/writes, include all prior/current M5 evidence +root M5_* files, both new namespaces, all old/new owned cache/targets; disk floor. Count stored allocated and logical sizes.
fixture_instance_reuse_limit: 104+ planned subcases do not imply one VM each: exact failed-negative groups may reuse verified unchanged native prestate; ABI/dust/metadata/positive-generated setup remains fresh; maximum100 VMs and5000 total native attempts, otherwise stop/report.
